uncited: Rendering and Post-Processing handles the visual presentation of blocky voxel meshes generated by [Blocky meshing](31-blocky-meshing.md), addressing transparency artifacts and geometric jaggedness.

It sets itself apart from sibling methods like [Greedy face merging](8935-greedy-face-merging.md) by operating on pre-generated geometry to optimize rendering order or refine surface topology, rather than modifying the initial mesh extraction topology.
The family shares the input of a coarse quadrilateral or triangular mesh derived from voxel data and the output of a rasterized image or refined mesh.
